'''Jared Goodwin 311 Inspired This Deck''' is a [[Dark]] capture list [[Jared Goodwin]] posted with The Drug Lords of Kirdo III.<ref name="list-49995">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/49995.html? swccg-discussion message #49995], [[Jared Goodwin]] (1 July 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000110061401/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/49995.html? Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jared Goodwin]]
* '''Published:''' 1 July 1998 (swccg-discussion)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]] (from the card pool)
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Jabba's Palace|JP-D-tatooinejabbaspalace.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' 311 Inspired This Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE Court Goodwin DS 1998.txt |Download]]
